description: Show which EU AI Act application dates (Article 113) have been reached as of a given date: which phases apply and which do not yet apply. The Regulation itself entered into force on 1 August 2024; this tool reports dates of application, not entry into force.

date.description: ISO date, e.g. "2027-06-01". Defaults to today.

name: get_deadlines

applies.description: True when the date has been reached on as_of, i.e. the phase applies

items.description: Clause-level citation: clause (e.g. "Article 5(1)(ba)"), the article's official heading, and the euaiactlaw.com paragraph permalink (#/article/N/<anchor>).

in_force.description: Deprecated alias of applies (same value), kept for compatibility; it does not indicate entry into force
